en: Black‑and‑white image of a small neo‑Gothic villa or manor house with a crenellated tower on the right side, circular attic windows, and simple rectangular windows on the main façade. There is a striped awning over the ground‑floor terrace, climbing plants and a formal garden in the foreground, with benches along a path and a gazebo to the right, all surrounded by dense trees. No visible printed caption or writing appears on the image.
